title: Employer Bulletin: October 2026
text:
HMRC publishes the employer bulletin 6 times a year, giving employers and agents the latest information on topics and issues that may affect them. 

 The October edition of employer bulletin includes articles on: 

 • 
 Payrolling benefits in kind — update on globally mobile employee exceptions and Class 1A National Insurance contributions

 • 
 Make your PAYE Settlement Agreement (PSA) payment by 22 October 2026

 • 
 Mandatory tax adviser registration for payroll agents opens 18 November 2026

 • 
 Changes to trade union law — what employers need to know

 • 
 2026 Tell ABAB Report

 • 
 There is still time to help your parent or carer employees receive the Child Benefit payments they are entitled to

 You can register for  HMRC’s employer email alert service  to receive emails from HMRC which tell you when the latest issue is available. 

 You can read the bulletin on screen or print it off. It is compatible with most screen reading software packages.
changeNote: Guidance has been updated to make clear that the ‘mandatory payrolling of benefits in kind expenses’ guidance will be updated in autumn and information that has not yet been confirmed to be included in the update has been removed.
